tools.name: search_yachts
tools.description: Search published yacht listings by literal text, type, location, year and asking price. Price filters require explicit currency; unknown values are excluded from filtered results. Availability and tax status are not independently verified.

tools.name: get_yacht_details
tools.description: Retrieve one published yacht using its exact inventory ID, including original public photograph URLs where available.

tools.name: compare_yachts
tools.description: Retrieve two to five published yachts side by side as reported, without converting currencies or estimating market value.

tools.name: find_buyer_requests
tools.description: Search only published confirmed editorial buyer briefs. No private buyers or CRM records. Confirmation is not a guarantee of current intent.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Retrieve public BUYERO services and enquiry URLs. Does not submit an enquiry.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_yacht_details, get_services · Private data: find_buyer_requests · Public sink: get_services.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_yacht_details, get_services · Private data: find_buyer_requests · Public sink: get_services

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
